snippet.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is an immersive co-operative action game where you tackle perilous fires in the American Midwest. A new trailer dropped during the Summer Showcase, noting that the game is coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox in Fall 2025.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #firefightingsimulator 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
